source: Best-effort research (Claude WebSearch result snippets + trained knowledge as of ~January 2026). This is NOT a verbatim download of the official NSE Indices constituent file.
verification_blocked_reason: Outbound network access from the build environment to niftyindices.com, en.wikipedia.org, and dhan.co all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED at the time this file was generated, so the authoritative CSV (https://niftyindices.com/IndexConstituent/ind_nifty50list.csv) could not be fetched or diffed against directly.
action_required: Before trusting any signal produced by 50.py, download the current constituent CSV from https://niftyindices.com/IndexConstituent/ind_nifty50list.csv yourself and reconcile the 'symbols' list below against it. Replace this file's 'symbols' array (and bump 'as_of') as often as NSE Indices revises the index -- nominally the last trading day of March and September, but ad hoc changes also occur.
pending_index_changes_effective_2026_09_: Multiple sources (search snippets, not independently confirmed here) report NSE Indices changes to Nifty 50 effective 2026-09-30: Wipro (WIPRO) exiting to Nifty Next 50, BSE Ltd (BSE) entering. Some sources described a larger reshuffle also naming Indian Hotels, Lodha Developers, REC, Shree Cement and United Spirits as exiting and Hitachi Energy India, Polycab India, Vedanta Aluminium Metal and Vodafone Idea as entering -- this could not be reconciled precisely from this environment. This file reflects WIPRO as still current (pre-2026-09-30). Re-verify after that date regardless.

known_gaps_between_this_list_and_the_liv.SBILIFE: Widely reported NIFTY 50 constituent (SBI Life Insurance) but absent from the live PSYGRID /public/live.json universe at the time this file was built. 50.py will correctly report it as unavailable rather than fabricate data for it.
known_gaps_between_this_list_and_the_liv.LTIM: Widely reported NIFTY 50 constituent (LTIMindtree) but absent from the live PSYGRID universe at the time this file was built. Same handling as SBILIFE.
known_gaps_between_this_list_and_the_liv.TMPV: Tata Motors demerged into separate passenger-vehicle (TMPV) and commercial-vehicle entities; the PSYGRID universe carries TMPV, not the legacy TATAMOTORS symbol, so this list uses TMPV.
